description_en: Updates sub-account information, including the nickname and remarks
description_zh: 用来更新子账户信息，包括昵称和注释
name: SetAccountInfo

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the sub-account. For enterprise customers, this is the company name. For T2 partners, this is the partner name
parameters.help_zh: 子账户昵称。 对于企业客户，是公司名称。 对于T2伙伴，则是伙伴名称
parameters.name: account_nickname

parameters.help_en: The customer business manager. Maximum length: 50 characters
parameters.name: customer_bd

Code.description_en:
The result code. Valid values:
200: OK.
1109: A system error occurred.
3030: The account nickname exceeds the maximum length of 150 bytes.
3031: The remark exceeds the maximum length of 3000 bytes
Code.description_zh:
结果码
错误代码:
200 OK
1109 系统错误
3030 账户昵称超过最大长度，最大长度150 bytes
3031 Remark超过最大长度，最大长度是3000 Bytes

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud uses this ID for error tracking
RequestId.description_zh: request ID，阿里云会根据这个进行错误跟踪

Success.description_en: Valid values: True and False. Indicates whether the current API call itself is successful. This does not indicate the success of subsequent business operations
Success.description_zh: 候选值:True/False，代表了是否当前API调用本身是成功 的。不代表后续业务操作的成功
